stories.title: Cold Hands Surprise
stories.description: A light, playful moment between a husband and wife at home that ends with a funny surprise.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic indoor shot of a cozy modern living room connected to a kitchen. Multiple elements: a wife standing at the kitchen sink washing dishes, warm indoor lighting, soft reflections on plates, water running gently. In the background, the husband sits relaxed on a sofa, focused on his smartphone, casual posture. Camera: slow steady forward dolly, calm domestic atmosphere, natural colors, realistic home environment, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: SETUP: Show normal home life. Wife doing chores, husband distracted on his phone.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, subtitles, watermark, logo, cartoon, anime, oversaturated, blurry, low quality, flicker, jitter
scenes.narration: She was busy. He was distracted.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot inside the living room. The wife quietly turns off the tap, wipes her hands, and looks toward her husband with a playful expression. She slowly walks toward him while he remains focused on his phone. Camera: slow smooth lateral movement following her approach, natural body motion, soft lighting, realistic facial expressions, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: BUILD-UP: Wife notices husband ignoring her and decides to surprise him.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium cinematic shot of the couple on the sofa. The wife gently slips her cold hands under the husband’s t-shirt from the side. Multiple elements: husband reacting with sudden shock, shoulders jumping slightly, phone almost slipping, wife smiling mischievously. Camera: stable framing with slight natural reaction movement, realistic expressions, playful mood, warm indoor lighting, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: PAYOFF: The cold-hands prank. Focus on expressions and reaction, not fast motion.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of the couple laughing together on the sofa. Multiple elements: husband laughing in surprise, wife pulling her hands back and laughing, phone resting on the couch, warm cozy lighting filling the room. Camera: slow gentle pull-back, calm and happy mood, realistic emotions, natural colors, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: ENDING: Light-hearted moment and shared laughter.
